decided: The supported collection surface narrows to two backends: CloudWatch (cloudwatch exporter + cwinsights querier) and Prometheus (prometheus exporter + promql querier), with the backend-neutral sql events querier retained. The otlp, datadog, statsd, splunkhec, and loki exporters and the logql and spl queriers are deleted outright — modules, go.work entries, and the loggolden harness's Loki half — and CI's golden job drops the Loki matrix step. Git history is the attic; no deprecation directory.
why: Explicit founder direction (2026-08-29): 'Forget everything else and just keep cloudwatch and prometheus... go deep and clean the house to provide such simplicity as a most common usecase.' Seven vendor surfaces cost review, CI wall-clock, and doc honesty for backends no pilot uses; the most common use case deserves the whole polish budget. sql stays because the prometheus exporter is metrics-only — without a neutral events sink a Prometheus shop loses the realized/customers legs and the zero-dependency quickstart dies.
cost_if_wrong: Re-adding a deleted adapter is a git revert plus a go.work line — cheap and reviewable. The expensive error would be the opposite: carrying seven unowned surfaces into the public flip.
alternatives: Attic/deprecated directory — rejected: pre-release repo, no external consumers, git history preserves everything
Keep modules but drop from CI/docs — rejected: unowned code that still compiles is a standing docs-accuracy lie
Also delete the sql querier — rejected as the named default (founder may override): it is the Prometheus shop's events path and the quickstart's zero-dep demo, not a vendor collector
scope: Deletes adapters/export/{otlp,datadog,statsd,splunkhec,loki} and adapters/query/{logql,spl}; go.work; test/loggolden trimmed to the CloudWatch/LocalStack parity; .github/workflows/ci.yml golden job loses the Loki step (this tracked item is explicitly about CI wiring per the forbidden-paths policy); docs sweep in the same PR (README, adapters.md, quickstart, integration doc). Keeps incident writers, payment/stripe, httpbatch, sql. No repo.yaml change needed — its adapter description stays true.
